turns.text: Good morning everyone. Today we are going to learn about photosynthesis. Can anyone tell me, what do plants need to make their own food?
turns.speaker: Teacher

turns.text: Excellent answer. And where does photosynthesis take place in the plant cell?
turns.speaker: Teacher

turns.text: Now, why do you think leaves are green? It's because of a pigment called chlorophyll. Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light and reflects green light. Does everyone understand this so far?
turns.speaker: Teacher

turns.text: Let's move to the next topic. What is the difference between photosynthesis and respiration?
turns.speaker: Teacher

turns.text: Respiration uses oxygen and releases carbon dioxide, but photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and releases oxygen.
turns.speaker: Student

turns.text: Very good, that is a complete answer. Now let's do a quick activity. Open your textbooks to page 42. Has everyone found the diagram?
turns.speaker: Teacher

turns.text: Please label the parts of the leaf shown in the diagram.
turns.speaker: Teacher
